questions.title: Debugging with byebug and pry
questions.direct_answer: byebug is a step debugger: drop `byebug` in your code and execution pauses there — you can step (next/step), inspect variables (type a name), continue (c), and see where you are (whereami). pry is a powerful REPL and exploration tool: `binding.pry` pauses and drops you into an interactive shell where you can inspect, try code, and view source (show-source). pry-byebug combines both (pry's REPL + byebug's stepping). In Rails, `binding.pry` (or `byebug`) in a controller/model pauses the request; rails console --sandbox lets you experiment without saving. Remove breakpoints before committing. Use byebug to step through logic, pry to explore objects and try ideas interactively.
